title: GLM: The Gaussian Latent Machine — Efficient Prior and Posterior Sampling for Inverse Problems
description: Complete source code to reproduce all experimental results from the paper "The Gaussian Latent Machine: Efficient Prior and Posterior Sampling for Inverse Problems" (arXiv:2505.12836, accepted at the SIAM Journal on Imaging Sciences). Developed as part of NEO (Next Generation Molecular Data Storage), Horizon Europe grant agreement No. 101115317.
